correctness.rationale: The trace is onto (its defining polynomial has degree q³<q⁴ and is nonzero), so ker τ has size q³. For z=x+x^q one has z+z^(q²)=τ(x) and τ(G_q(x))=τ(x)(1+τ(z^(q−1))). This proves the zero-input-trace case. For nonzero w, z=wy reduces to y^(q²)+y=1 and τ(y^(q−1))=1, with exactly q lifts per qualifying y by the image and kernel of x↦x+x^q. With t=y+y^q, v=y²+y, h=t²+t, we have t^q=t+1 and v^q=v+h, so h has absolute trace one. The tower trace gives τ(y^(q−1))=t/v+(t+1)/(v+h), where the denominators are nonzero. Writing b=v+th yields b²+(h+1)b+h³=0. For h≠1 the Artin–Schreier right side h³/(h+1)²=h+(h+1)^−1+(h+1)^−2 still has trace one, impossible. For h=1, b=1, s is odd and y²+y=t+1 with t²+t=1; thus y⁴+y=1 and y⁸+y=t. The four distinct roots from the two t's lie in F16⊂F_(q^4), and satisfy the required q-Frobenius exactly for s≡3 mod 4. Hence the total fiber exceeds q³ exactly in that class, excluding permutations there but making no other permutation assertion. `python3 /workspace/branches/independent_checks.py 3` verifies field irreducibility and enumerates G_q in alternate polynomial bases for q=4,8,16, giving totals 64,736,4096 and checking every input trace class. This is bounded corroboration; the uploaded checker was inspected, not executed.
